risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company references cybersecurity risks in Item 1A of the 10-K, but specific details are limited. Severity is moderate given standard operational exposure.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive power components market. Strategy relies on product differentiation through proprietary innovations and unique architectures such as FPA.

risks.title: Supply Chain Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company heavily relies on outsourced assembly processes for critical advanced products. Disruptions have reduced revenue and margins, and tariffs cost 3,949 million in 2025.

risks.title: Regulatory and Tariff Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to government regulations and import tariffs on raw materials. Increased tariffs and freight costs directly impacted gross margin in 2025.

risks.title: Litigation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company resolved the SynQor litigation in 2025 (19.5 million charge in 2024, zero in 2025). Active pending litigation appears controlled and documented in Note 16.

risks.title: Demand Volatility and Operational Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Quarterly results are difficult to predict and subject to significant fluctuations due to changes in customer forecasts, macroeconomic factors, and electronics cyclicality. Direct impacts on production volumes, inventory levels, and margins.

ai_positioning.summary: Vicor has established a leadership position in the emerging market segment for powering high-performance processors used for acceleration of artificial intelligence applications. Vicor's customers in this segment include leading innovators in processor and accelerator design, as well as early adopters in cloud computing and high-performance computing. Vicor's advanced products, based on the proprietary Factorized Power Architecture (FPA), serve large Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), Original Design Manufacturers (ODMs), and their contract manufacturers, with sales currently concentrated in the data center and hyperscaler segments of enterprise computing.
evidence: We have established a leadership position in the emerging market segment for powering high-performance processors used for acceleration of applications associated with artificial intelligence (AI).
Our customers in the AI market segment include the leading innovators in processor and accelerator design, as well as early adopters in cloud computing and high performance computing.

With our Advanced Products, we generally serve large Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), Original Design Manufacturers (ODMs), and their contract manufacturers, with sales currently concentrated in the data center and hyperscaler segments of enterprise computing.
